title: Avanzan alianzas para dotar de tecnología para fortalecer la seguridad
summary: Guatemala's Ministry of the Interior (Ministerio de Gobernación) reports a meeting between its Vice Minister of Security and a UAE Embassy delegation, which presented a portfolio of security technologies as part of the ministry's efforts to incorporate advanced technology through international alliances. The secure communications and cybersecurity solutions analysed included post-quantum encryption systems and cryptographic satellites, which would help protect strategic information.
